temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Shirley appears somber; in conversation Shirley says it has been tough and that she keeps thinking whether more could have been done for the patient.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is a caring colleague who was affected by the patient's death, but she does not yet know the depth of Shirley's grief or possible guilt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Sara's suspicion that Shirley is deeply affected is confirmed, and she learns Shirley may be doubting whether more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is grieving and may feel some responsibility for the patient's outcome; Shirley needs reassurance and support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort Shirley and reassure her that they provided good care and did everything they could.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Shirley explicitly says she feels responsible and wonders if pushing for a different treatment approach might have given the patient a better chance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving and may feel some responsibility, but she is not yet certain how strongly Shirley blames herself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Sara learns that Shirley's sense of responsibility is explicit, specific, and burdensome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is carrying significant guilt about the treatment decisions and needs help sharing and easing that burden.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Talk through the treatment decisions with Shirley, reassure her, and help alleviate her sense of responsibility.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley has remained reserved and minimally expressive. When confronted, Shirley says she fears seeming unprofessional or weak, but admits she may try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley feels responsible and is grieving, and that she has been holding back emotionally despite Sara's earlier support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Sara learns that Shirley's emotional restraint comes from fear of appearing unprofessional or weak, and that Shirley is at least willing to try opening up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley needs a safe, nonjudgmental space to express emotion, and that encouragement may help her open up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to express her feelings and reassure her that showing emotion is healthy and acceptable among friends.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara reflects that her previous confrontation may have been too harsh and apologizes. Shirley says it was a bit much but knows Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and says continued talking helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley fears appearing weak or unprofessional and may be trying to open up, but Sara worries her earlier confrontation may have been too forceful and harmed their rapport.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Sara learns her worry was partly valid, but the relationship remains intact; Shirley accepts the apology and values the conversations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is receptive to her support and wants to keep talking, so their friendship and supportive connection can be maintained.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Mend the friendship, continue being available, and maintain supportive communication with Shirley.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Shirley seems to be doing better and says she feels better thanks to their talks and Sara's support. Shirley accepts Sara's suggestion to spend time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley has been receptive to support and is trying to open up, but she is not yet certain how much Shirley has improved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Sara's hope is confirmed; Shirley attributes improvement to their talks and support, and she is open to deepening their connection outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is improving and that their supportive relationship is helping; Shirley is willing to spend more time together socially.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Shirley and plan to spend time together outside work, such as over the weekend.
